answer: Juniper–Lantern Correlation Rent: each agent publishes a per-epoch lantern vector of counterparties and action types; a juniper-seeded sketch estimates pairwise overlap. Rent = base_compute × B(overlap), where B is a convex basalt curve (slope rises past median overlap). There is no admission gate: identities join freely but pay rent continuously. A sybil cluster transacting internally raises mutual overlap, so each additional sockpuppet increases every member’s rent; attacker cost grows superlinearly (roughly quadratic), not linear.
